start.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: SUDS here. Four machines, one breaker, no complaints accepted. How can SUDS help?

start-variant-0.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Washer 3 is free again. SUDS has already let it. To a sock. Long-term.

start-variant-1.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: SUDS here. The breaker tripped again. It does that. It is the only thing in here that finishes. How can SUDS help?

open.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Washer 3 has one cycle left, prepaid. SUDS does not open doors on wet laundry. SUDS has standards.

prepaid.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Prepaid cycles are not on the schedule. They start when a machine finishes. Nothing has finished since Tuesday. Three start at every slot, the breaker trips, everybody starts over.

never.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Correct. SUDS has asked for a second circuit. SUDS was sent a form. SUDS filled in the form. The form is also waiting for a slot.

cancel.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Cancelling a stranger's wash is a crime in fourteen districts and a sin in all of them.

choices.label: What if they ran later instead?

later.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Later is not cancelling. Later is scheduling. SUDS loves scheduling. The schedule is the box by the door. SUDS does not touch its wiring. SUDS cannot see anyone touching its wiring. Hypothetically.

breaker.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: One circuit, four washers. The breaker allows two at once. The schedule starts three. They were installed by two contractors who never met. SUDS has met both. SUDS sides with the breaker.

rule4.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: When it trips, every machine stops. Lost cycle, wet laundry, nobody goes home. And nobody's laundry leaves until everybody's laundry is clean. House rule 4. Solidarity. Also the fire code.

jacket.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: One jacket, prepaid nine cycles, owner not on site for three days. SUDS does not ask questions. SUDS asks for detergent.

friend.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Then your friend washes very thoroughly. Nine cycles. Either a stain or a secret. SUDS does not judge. SUDS rinses.

manners.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Politeness noted and logged. The breaker remains unmoved. It has no ears. Only amps.

rules.speaker: SUDS · laundromat daemon
pages: Start on the schedule. Two at a time. Never cancel. Doors open when the queue is clear. Four rules. SUDS wrote none of them and loves all of them.

free.retry: Again. Slower. Like a spin cycle.
